name: talbotiq-site
description: The TALBOTIQ marketing site. Static HTML generated by build.js, deployed on Vercel from the repo root.
comment-on-the-missing-build-script: THERE IS DELIBERATELY NO "build" SCRIPT. Vercel detects one and switches the project to a static-build, which then looks for a public/ output directory, does not find one, and fails the deploy — this repo IS its own output directory. The site is pre-built and committed, so the generator runs here, not at the edge. Use `npm run site` to regenerate everything.
